source: Figures of the vendor guidance pages Tab bars, Toolbars and Sheets (fetched 2026-11-15), measured in a scratch folder; images not kept. Figure width 536 px equals the full phone screen width. Points assume a 402 pt wide phone.

tabBarExpanded.currentItem: a lighter capsule lens inset about 4 pt inside the bar, concentric

tabBarMinimised: current tab as a separate circle at the leading corner, the accessory as a capsule in the middle, search as a separate circle at the trailing corner

topToolbarGroups.shape: capsule per group, borderless symbols, no bar background

sheetMediumDetent.closeButton: circle about 44 pt at the top leading corner
sheetMediumDetent.grabber: short capsule centred at the top
